from datetime import datetime,timezone
import json
from v3_revision import ROOT,dump
# One independent symmetric increment Uniform[-1,1], x=0,H=1.

assert L>peak_target and 1-L==Fraction(25,1000)
r=dict(actual_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),analytic_fixture='H1,x0,X1 Uniform[-1,1]; peak=abs(X1) Uniform[0,1]',peak_point95_quantile=str(peak_target),endpoint_absolute_point975_quantile_and_L=str(L),L_strict_breach_probability=str(1-L),interpretation='Same peak response and scoring preference permit comparing L, but the endpoint-derived bound is not generally the exact peak .95 quantile.',new_financial_or_Monte_Carlo_experiment=False)
dump(ROOT/'results/revision-20261023/round2/post-correction-audit/endpoint-bound-estimand-clarification.json',r);print(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
